responsibility: Implements the core GNU Modula-2 runtime support services. It delegates module dependency ordering to M2Dependent, maintains lists of initial and termination procedures, controls HALT/exit behavior and error-message emission, tracks halting/termination state, and provides the concrete exception-entry routines that generated code calls to raise M2EXCEPTION categories through RTExceptions with file, line, column, and scope metadata.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable implementation half of the M2RTS pair: unlike M2RTS.def's API declarations, it defines the initialization/termination procedure lists, HALT state tracking, delegation to M2Dependent, and the actual exception-entry routines that invoke RTExceptions.Raise.
